notes.title: Update 1.03 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]NEW SIMULATOR MODE:
[list]
[*]New walking control mode: Tap on "D" and "A" to do a new step.
[*]mr.President can't move injured limbs in simulator mode.
[/list]
[*]Bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1 notes (09.22.2016)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Cutscene and dialogs now can be skipped (hold Space to skip cutscene)
[*]Scene 6 ending now can be skipped (hold E to skip the ladder scene) NOTE: "Top Of The Ladder" achievement won't be unlocked!
[*]Minor bug fixes
[/list]
